description: (needs account token) Set or remove a site's browser icon (favicon) or its share preview image. Pass the image as content (base64) or, with the local server, file (a path on this computer). clear=true removes it. Works once the site has its own domain. No money. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.

content.description: The image file as standard base64 (PNG, JPEG, SVG, ICO, WebP).

file.description: Local server only: path to the image file on this computer.

filename.description: Optional: the file name, e.g. logo.png.

site.description: The address of a site on this account (from list_sites).

name: set_site_image
